_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 007, July-September 2023: XxwF--X7PLo, jx6fBGkMNTI, Pio0TQ9YvD0, SCXTYJcPb7o, tF2mSIr1Pm8, dvqTha9uG8Q, EJ3Rtm3uJQw, kIXRUu8-f-c. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He holds that the seven-year tribulation begins on a shmita cycle and that its manifestation comes at the end of one, so another seven-year cycle follows this one.
mentions.quote: The seven years tribulation starts on a schmita cycle
mentions.time_phrase: at the end of a shmita cycle
mentions.falsify_match: Events read as tribulation beginning at a shmita boundary.
mentions.falsify_miss: The shmita boundary passes with nothing of the kind.

mentions.claim_text: Looking at spring he notes the eclipse paths crossing America run right over the New Madrid fault.
mentions.quote: whenever the eclipses go over America and it goes right over the New Madrid
mentions.falsify_match: A New Madrid event around the April 2024 eclipse.
mentions.falsify_miss: The eclipse passes with no New Madrid activity.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that the two-state solution dividing the land of Israel is meant to be finished by March, within six to twelve months, with construction of the Third Temple starting.
mentions.quote: dividing the land of Israel done by March
mentions.time_phrase: by March, within six to twelve months
mentions.falsify_match: A land-division agreement concluded by August 2024 with Third Temple work beginning.
mentions.falsify_miss: No agreement and no temple construction.

mentions.claim_text: March carries another major event, with Saudi Arabia given rule over all the holy sites under the crown prince.
mentions.quote: Saudi Arabia will rule over all the holy sites
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi Arabia takes custodianship of the Jerusalem holy sites.

mentions.claim_text: He says famine may be all around but he refuses to participate in it, in the financial crash or in the Great Depression, because scripture never says believers must suffer through it.
mentions.quote: I refuse to participate in the financial crash
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on the hearer's own stance of faith
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a posture toward events rather than a claim about them.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to believe for the impossible because God is no respecter of persons and will do for them what he did for others.
mentions.quote: believe for the impossible believe the impossible
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: Everything is being sped up and coming fast, and Jesus Christ is coming, though he says he never quotes a time frame for the return.
mentions.quote: this is being sped up big time
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; he explicitly declines to date it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; he declines to date it.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a 2014 visitation, about ten years earlier, after which he expected the return immediately, and notes that ten years passed instead.
mentions.quote: this was back in 2014 this is going on 10 years ago
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a self-correcting note about his own past expectation.

mentions.claim_text: He has it in his spirit that something big is going to happen, and reports Saudi Arabia joining the BRICS nations on 1 January 2024, five months out.
mentions.quote: they are going to join the brakes Nation on January the 1st of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi Arabia's BRICS membership takes effect on 1 January 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: Accession does not take effect on that date.

mentions.claim_text: He points to radioactive water released from Japan's plant poisoning the ocean, and to Trump's mug shot on the 24th as something that has never happened before.
mentions.quote: poisoning all of the ocean with their Power Plant
mentions.falsify_match: Fukushima water release began and Trump was booked on 24 August 2023.

mentions.claim_text: Praying with urgency he has seen a short-haired brown-haired woman doing something in November, and has been praying about it.
mentions.quote: a short haired brown-haired woman doing something in November
mentions.condition_text: he says he has been praying about it
mentions.falsify_match: A woman matching that description takes a consequential public action in November 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says great things are coming for 2024 and touches on the Democratic party, defending his mentioning politics at all.
mentions.quote: great things coming for 2024
mentions.falsify_match: 2024 is broadly a good year.

mentions.claim_text: Going into 2024 he saw them pumping the economy full of money to make everything look good, and the Lord told him 2024 will be a year of soaring and a good year, though not in every aspect.
mentions.quote: 2024 will be a year that we will soar
mentions.falsify_match: Heavy fiscal or monetary stimulus in 2024 alongside a broadly good year.
mentions.falsify_miss: No stimulus, or a bad year.

mentions.claim_text: Another wave like the early 2000s is coming, this time built on digital platforms and cryptocurrencies, with a shifting into a new era.
mentions.quote: I saw it being with digital platforms digital cryptos
mentions.falsify_match: A dot-com-scale boom centred on digital assets.

mentions.claim_text: There is something about 24 August and something about praying over September, though he says he hates quoting dates because seeing in the spirit has depth perception.
mentions.quote: there's something about August 24th and I hate quoting dates
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event on 24 August or in September 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He instructs listeners to give thanks so that praises go up and blessings come down, and says he was in prayer about 2024 the night before.
mentions.quote: when praises go up, blessings come down
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He saw a great financial harvest laid out like stacked dominoes across the years and months ahead, with the Lord saying a financial shift is coming.
mentions.quote: I saw a great financial harvest they were like dominoes stacked up
mentions.falsify_match: A sequential chain of financial transfers to his audience.

mentions.claim_text: Looking into 2024 he says it is not a bad year but a blessed one, using the image of a coin with two sides.
mentions.quote: 2024 is not a bad year. It's a blessed year
mentions.falsify_match: 2024 is broadly a good year.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks healing over Megan, declaring she is healed by the stripes of Jesus and has the mind of Christ, and refuses to speak a death word.
mentions.quote: Megan is healed by the stripes of Jesus
mentions.condition_text: spoken as a declaration of faith
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a private healing declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He warns that change may take a while after years of speaking wrongly, and tells listeners not to give in when told their life will never change.
mentions.quote: It may take a little bit, but don't give up
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He tells of someone handing him a check for $3,500 to clear his hospital bills just as his wages were about to be garnished. A past testimony.
mentions.quote: check for $3,500 the Lord told me to give you this
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a past testimony.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know where the channel leads, only that God told him to be on YouTube, and notes he has reached 50,000 subscribers since starting in about February.
mentions.quote: all I know is God told me to be on YouTube
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable as a prediction; a statement about the channel's origin.

mentions.claim_text: He saw a large bird dumping worms into the mouths of baby birds and prays that the Holy Spirit will meet every need listeners have.
mentions.quote: I saw that big bird dump a whole bunch of worms on them little babies
mentions.condition_text: spoken as a prayer over listeners
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a provision declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to stand and not give up for healings, miracles and finances, saying that even with nothing to eat God brings forth what is needed.
mentions.quote: he'll bring forth the finances that you need
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on standing and not giving up
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a provision instruction.

mentions.claim_text: Third on his list, he was told to pray against large gatherings of people being hit by mass shootings, which he calls an assignment being sent out.
mentions.quote: he had me pray against big large Gatherings of people for Mass shootings
mentions.condition_text: given as an assignment to pray against
mentions.falsify_match: Mass shootings at large gatherings increase in the period following.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such increase, which he pre-attributes to the prayer.
